exactText: Some form of AI, probably neurosymbolic in nature, will come that is far more economical and data- and energy-efficient than LLMs, and it will make an absolute fortune.
sourceQuote: Some form of AI, probably neurosymbolic in nature, will come that is far more economical and data- and energy-efficient than LLMs, and it will make an absolute fortune.
normalizedClaim: A more economical, data- and energy-efficient form of AI (likely neurosymbolic) will emerge and generate substantial profits.
resolutionCriteria: Commercial success and market valuation of neurosymbolic or hybrid AI systems significantly outperforming pure LLMs on cost/efficiency metrics by 2032, per company financials and industry reports.

exactText: LLMs, on the other hand, will never be all that profitable (aside from the chip companies selling shovels in the gold rush).
sourceQuote: LLMs, on the other hand, will never be all that profitable (aside from the chip companies selling shovels in the gold rush).
normalizedClaim: Large language model companies (excluding chipmakers) will never achieve high profitability.
resolutionCriteria: Sustained low or negative operating margins for major pure-play LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) through 2032, as reported in financial disclosures or reliable estimates.

exactText: We won’t get to AGI in 2026 (or 7).
sourceQuote: We won’t get to AGI in 2026 (or 7).
normalizedClaim: AGI will not be achieved in 2026 or 2027.
resolutionCriteria: No widely accepted demonstration or consensus declaration of AGI by major labs or independent evaluators by the end of 2027.

exactText: we will not get to AGI in 2026.
sourceQuote: we will not get to AGI in 2026.
normalizedClaim: AGI will not be achieved in 2026.
resolutionCriteria: Absence of consensus AGI achievement by December 31, 2026, per primary lab announcements and independent assessments.

exactText: If we focus on the other three AGI may be achievable, possibly in the next decade.
sourceQuote: AGI may be achievable, possibly in the next decade.
normalizedClaim: With focus on world models, reliable reasoning, and explicit knowledge, AGI may be achievable in the next decade (by ~2036).
resolutionCriteria: Achievement of AGI (or clear path with major progress on the three listed components) by 2036, documented in technical literature.

exactText: I stand by my prediction that it might happen next decade but that we won’t reach it this decade.
sourceQuote: we won’t reach it this decade.
normalizedClaim: AGI will not be reached in the 2020s (i.e., by 2030).
resolutionCriteria: No consensus AGI achievement by December 31, 2030.

exactText: Human domestic robots like Optimus and Figure will be all demo and very little product.
sourceQuote: Human domestic robots like Optimus and Figure will be all demo and very little product.
normalizedClaim: Humanoid domestic robots such as Optimus and Figure will remain primarily demonstration systems with minimal real consumer product deployment in the near term.
resolutionCriteria: Limited commercial household deployment numbers and critical independent reviews of Optimus/Figure-style robots through 2028, per company sales data and product reviews.

exactText: Reliable general-purpose AI agents won’t come in 2024 Reliable general-purpose AI agents won’t come in 2025 Reliable general-purpose AI agents probably won’t come in 2026 or 2027 either.
sourceQuote: Reliable general-purpose AI agents probably won’t come in 2026 or 2027 either.
normalizedClaim: Reliable general-purpose AI agents will not arrive in 2026 or 2027.
resolutionCriteria: Absence of widely deployed, reliable general-purpose AI agents capable of robust multi-step real-world tasks by end of 2027, per independent benchmarks and enterprise adoption reports.

exactText: AGI is not imminent, and LLMs are not the royal road to getting there.
sourceQuote: AGI is not imminent, and LLMs are not the royal road to getting there.
normalizedClaim: AGI is not imminent, and the pure LLM paradigm is not the path to achieving it.
resolutionCriteria: Continued failure of pure scaling of LLMs to produce AGI, with alternative approaches (neurosymbolic, world models) showing superior progress by 2030.

exactText: Today’s gigantic bets are premature, and most won’t pay off.
sourceQuote: Today’s gigantic bets are premature, and most won’t pay off.
normalizedClaim: The majority of the large capital investments currently being made in generative AI will not generate adequate returns.
resolutionCriteria: Significant write-downs, failed ROI, or bankruptcies among major generative AI investments made in 2024–2026, visible in financial reports by 2030.
